question: Nupur Arts' Artistic Director _________ is 2021’s recipient of the One Dance UK Lifetime Achievement Award in South Asian Dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smita Vadnerkar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nupur Arts' Artistic Director **Smita Vadnerkar **is the 2021’s recipient of the **One Dance UK Lifetime Achievement Award in South Asian Dance.**
 
• Recognizing her 30+ years of hard work, dedication, and contribution to South Asian arts in the UK.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The recipients of the One Dance UK Awards 2021**
 
• Primary Dance Education Award
 
 
• **Alysha Kassam**
 
 
 
• Secondary Dance Education Award
 
 
• **Pippa Fisher-Coldwell**
 
 
 
• Inspirational Lecturer at College, University or Conservatoire Award
 
 
• **Michelle Man**
